title: a charter lands after its lab twin
intention: The commit door refuses a cairn commit on main, or a land into main, that changes an intention+why.json until the commons beside holds its lab copy, byte for byte, at its HEAD.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: since 10-16, 304 intention+why.json writes landed on cairn main; the commons lab (CairnCommons/intentions-congruency-lab) never held 13 of them and 64 more caught up 30 min to 19 h late, so about 25% of charter landings left the lab stale and every proof that reads the lab reds in that window (6fb272ba3d64's test_compiler red and 8c1329759813's PROVEME refusal were one such charter, 424 min stale). Nothing ties a cairn commit to its commons twin.
traces_to: Law 4 and Law 5: the thing and the story of the thing may live in two roots but may never contradict each other, and a rule that matters is enforced by the commit door, not by remembering to recompile.
how: A tester module cairn/devices/tester/lab_twin.py asks only when HEAD's symbolic-ref is refs/heads/main (a merge into main runs pre-merge-commit with HEAD still on main); a branch or detached commit passes untouched, because its twin can only land with the branch. On main it reads git diff --cached for intention+why.json paths (A, M, D; renames split). For each add or modify it names the lab copy with cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/compiler.py's lab_filename over gather_sources, reads the staged bytes (git show :path) and the commons twin at <repo>/../CairnCommons HEAD (git show HEAD:intentions-congruency-lab/<name>), and refuses when the twin is missing or differs. A deleted charter is refused while its copy still stands at commons HEAD. Charters gather_sources skips (proofs/, validations/, dot dirs) need no twin. No commons beside refuses, named. Each refusal line ends 'land the commons lab copy <name> first'. cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-commit runs it, blocking, after the first artifact check; a land reaches it through pre-merge-commit (db250e9bf3f9). The proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_charter_lands_after_its_lab_twin.py builds a scratch cairn and a scratch CairnCommons side by side, with the real hooks installed by install_hook, the real module and compiler, and A1's passing stub doors, and commits and merges for real.

clauses.claim: a commit staging a charter whose lab copy commons HEAD lacks is refused, HEAD unmoved, the refusal naming 'land the commons lab copy <name> first'; red on db250e9bf3f9's build, where it commits
a twin only in the commons working tree, or committed with other bytes, is refused the same way
with the twin committed at commons HEAD, byte for byte, the same commit lands
a non-conflicting merge of a branch that changes a charter with no landed twin is refused through pre-merge-commit, HEAD unmoved
a commit deleting a charter is refused while commons HEAD still holds its lab copy, naming the removal, and lands once the copy is gone
a charter under proofs/, which the compiler does not copy, commits with no twin
the change that reds on main (clause 1) commits on a builder's branch with no twin; red on 1ecb004a0, which judged every commit
the same change commits on a detached HEAD, which is how a hollow scratch worktree stands; red on 1ecb004a0

decisions.text: D1: cairn/devices/tester/lab_twin.py judges each staged charter against its lab copy at commons HEAD, naming it with the compiler's lab_filename.
D2: cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-commit runs it, blocking, after the first artifact check; a land reaches it through pre-merge-commit.
D3: one proof over a scratch cairn beside a scratch commons, one tooth per clause.

out: cairn/tools/artifact/hooks/pre-commit (the commons' hook, a sibling ticket)

measured.saw: 304 charter writes on cairn main since 10-16; the lab never held 13, and 64 caught up more than 30 min late
measured.how: for each commit touching an intention+why.json on origin/main since 10-16, the first commons commit whose lab copy held those bytes

measured.saw: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_charter_lands_after_its_lab_twin.py reds 5 of 6 teeth on 595b35854 (A1's build, no lab_twin.py) and is green on the build
measured.how: bin/cairn test --exec in a detached worktree at 595b35854 and in wt-pmc, scratch CAIRN_BUS_HOME

measured.saw: hollow never commits: cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py runs only cat-file, checkout --, diff, log, rev-list, rev-parse, show and merge-file, and its worktrees come from scratch_worktree, which adds them --detach (cairn/tools/scratch/scratch.py:688); teeth 7 and 8 red on 1ecb004a0 and green on the scoped build
measured.how: grep of every git verb in hollow.py, and bin/cairn test --exec of the proof in a detached worktree at 1ecb004a0
